title: Why this lecture?
text:
Why this lecture?
• This deck isolates generative text foundations from the larger Modern
LLMs chapter.
• Focus topics:
• tokenizer →ids, causal LM training (shifted labels),
• autoregressive inference and decoding control,
• KV-cache intuition and practical samples.
• Course samples live under DLA/slides/10-modern-llms/samples/.

title: Tokenization and vocabulary

Tokenization and vocabulary
Before tensors
• Raw text →tokenizer →ids xt ∈{0, . . . , |V| −1}.
• Subword tokenizers (BPE/SentencePiece) reduce unknown-word issues.
• Keep tokenizer and vocab consistent with the pretrained checkpoint.

title: GPT-style causal LM
text:
GPT-style causal LM
Decoder-only stack
• A stack of L decoder blocks with a causal mask.
• Position t can only attend to tokens ≤t.
• LM head maps hidden states to vocabulary logits.

title: Inference
text:
Inference
Autoregressive decoding
1 Provide prompt tokens.
2 Read logits at last position; sample or arg max next token.
3 Append token; repeat until stop condition.

title: Decoding hyperparameters
text:
Decoding hyperparameters
Temperature, top-k, top-p
• Temperature controls sharpness/randomness.
• Top-k keeps only k highest-probability candidates.
• Top-p (nucleus) keeps smallest prefix with cumulative mass ≥p.
• Repetition penalty can reduce loops.

title: Inference efficiency
text:
Inference efficiency
KV-cache (idea)
• Cache previous key/value tensors per layer.
• Avoid recomputing attention on old tokens every step.
• Faster long generation; memory still grows with sequence length.

title: Toy example
text:
Toy example
Character-level RNN generator
class CharRNNLM(nn.Module):
def __init__(self, vocab_size, embed_dim, hidden_size):
super().__init__()
self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim)
self.rnn = nn.GRU(embed_dim, hidden_size, batch_first=True)
self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_size, vocab_size)

title: Summary
text:
Summary
What to remember
• AR factorization + causal decoder-only architecture are core.
• Training uses shifted labels and teacher forcing.
• Inference quality depends strongly on decoding choices.
• See ModernLLMs.tex for LoRA/QLoRA and API deployment.
